# PixelVitals

> Tracking health monitoring for Shopify stores. PixelVitals watches a
> merchant's Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google Ads/GA4, and TikTok tracking around the
> clock and alerts them the moment it silently breaks — by comparing
> platform-reported events against actual Shopify orders.

Key facts:
- Problem: Shopify pixels can show "connected" while events silently stop;
  Shopify can throttle a pixel's data flow with no admin warning. Merchants
  typically discover breakage days later, after wasted ad spend.
- PixelVitals does NOT replace pixels or tracking apps; it monitors whatever
  setup the merchant already has. Nothing is injected into the storefront.
- Alerts state what broke, when, and the estimated untracked revenue since.
- Pricing: Starter $19/mo (daily checks, email alerts), Pro $39/mo (hourly
  checks, SMS/Slack alerts, untracked-revenue estimates).
- Status: early access — waitlist at https://pixelvitals.com
- Contact: hello@pixelvitals.com
